svg.title: Mount Fuji at dawn, from Kawaguchi-ko
svg.desc: A print in the woodblock manner. Fuji stands in blue shadow with a scalloped snowline; a low sun to the right throws pale rays across a sky that runs from deep blue to orange. Bands of mist lie across the middle of the mountain and it is mirrored, broken into horizontal bands, in the still lake below. A cherry branch with blossoms enters from the top left. A red torii stands in the water at left, its reflection a short red smear; two ducks swim near it. A boatman in a conical hat poles across the lake at right and a heron stands at the near shore. Reeds grow in dense stands and stones lie along the dark bank in the foreground. A vertical paper strip at left carries the title 富士山 and the place 河口湖 above a red seal. A stamp cancelled TOKYO sits at the top right. Lettering along the bottom edge reads 富嶽, MT. FUJI, 3,776 M, KAWAGUCHI-KO · JAPAN.
